changelog: Connect your own GitHub account: device login, personal token, or a public username. Nothing is bundled with the app
Apex API keys are verified live: replacing the key in /admin locks the old one immediately
Keyboard-safe dialogs: the key field and Unlock button stay above the Android keyboard
New Home and onboarding built around the Apex mark, with an engine status pill and four creation cards
Fast Direct Mode for local models; the agent harness is opt-in. Haptics are off by default
Expandable thinking traces, inline selection rewrite, and a full-screen Live Preview viewer for pages and slide decks
